privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.s1p1: RSA SOFT S.R.L. ("RSA SOFT", "we", "us") is the data controller for the personal data processed through this website. You can reach us at alex.rusu@rsasoft.ro.
privacyPolicy.s1p2: Full company registration details are listed on our Legal Notice page.
privacyPolicy.s2p1: We collect two categories of data:
privacyPolicy.s2li1: Data you give us directly: your name, email, phone number, company, and any message you send us when you book a call, submit a form, or contact us by email, WhatsApp, Telegram, LinkedIn, or XING.
privacyPolicy.s2li2: Data collected automatically, only if you consent to analytics cookies: pages visited, approximate location derived from your IP address, browser and device type, and referral source.
privacyPolicy.s3Title: 3. Why we process your data and on what legal basis
privacyPolicy.s3li1: To respond to your inquiry and discuss our custom software development services, based on your request and the steps needed to enter into a contract (Article 6(1)(b) GDPR).
privacyPolicy.s3li2: To understand how visitors use our website and improve it, based on your consent given through the cookie banner (Article 6(1)(a) GDPR).
privacyPolicy.s3li3: To keep our website secure and functioning correctly, based on our legitimate interest (Article 6(1)(f) GDPR).
privacyPolicy.s3li4: To comply with legal obligations, such as accounting and tax record-keeping (Article 6(1)(c) GDPR).
privacyPolicy.s4Title: 4. Who we share your data with
privacyPolicy.s4p1: We use a small number of service providers acting as data processors on our behalf: Google (Analytics, Calendar, and YouTube embeds) and our hosting provider. These providers may process data outside the European Economic Area, in which case we rely on the safeguards they provide, such as the EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework or Standard Contractual Clauses.
privacyPolicy.s4p2: We do not sell your personal data to anyone.
privacyPolicy.s5Title: 5. How long we keep your data
privacyPolicy.s5p1: We keep inquiry and contact data for as long as needed to handle your request, and afterwards only if required by law (for example, accounting records must be kept for the period set by Romanian tax law).
privacyPolicy.s5p2: Analytics data is retained according to Google Analytics' standard retention settings, and only if you have consented to analytics cookies.
privacyPolicy.s6p1: Under the GDPR, you have the right to:
privacyPolicy.s6li1: Access the personal data we hold about you
privacyPolicy.s6li4: Restrict how we process your data
privacyPolicy.s6li5: Receive your data in a portable format
privacyPolicy.s6li6: Object to processing based on our legitimate interest
privacyPolicy.s6li7: Withdraw your consent at any time, without affecting processing carried out before withdrawal
privacyPolicy.s6p2: You can also lodge a complaint with the Romanian National Supervisory Authority for Personal Data Processing (ANSPDCP) at www.dataprotection.ro, or with the supervisory authority in your own EU country of residence.

cookiePolicy.title: Cookie Policy
cookiePolicy.s1p1: Cookies are small text files stored on your device that help websites function and, when you agree, help us understand how visitors use our site.
cookiePolicy.s2p1: We only load Google Analytics after you accept cookies through our banner. Necessary cookies, which store your preferences, are always active.

cookiePolicy.necessary2: rsa-soft-lang (localStorage) — remembers your language preference (English, German, or Romanian).
cookiePolicy.analytics1: _ga, _ga_*, _gid (Google Analytics) — help us understand aggregate site usage. Set by Google only after you click "Accept All".
cookiePolicy.embeds1: YouTube (youtube-nocookie.com) — our video testimonials use YouTube's privacy-enhanced mode, which does not set cookies until you press play.
cookiePolicy.embeds2: Google Calendar — our booking widget is a Google Calendar iframe, which may set cookies from Google needed for the booking flow to work.
cookiePolicy.s3p1: You can accept or reject non-essential cookies at any time using the "Manage Cookie Settings" button above, the "Cookie Settings" link in the footer, or your browser's own cookie controls.

hero.badge: For Tech Founders & CTOs in DACH automotive, banking & fintech
hero.title: RSA SOFT fills a specialized software role on your team in 24 to 48 hours. Not 3 months.
hero.p4: Meanwhile your roadmap slips and your own team absorbs the extra load.
hero.step1Text: Scope: we get on a call and get it exact
hero.step2Text: Match: pulled from developers already vetted for your industry
hero.step3Text: Placement: a developer matched to your stack, ready to start

objections.eyebrow: The objection we hear every call
objections.p1: We hear this on almost every first call.
objections.p2: Here is the belief behind it.
objections.item2: Agencies are a middleman cutting into the developer's salary, so the developer isn't motivated.
objections.item3: Freelancers are a legal and financial risk.
objections.item4: Agency developers aren't in it for the long run, they job-hop.
objections.reframe1: The developer on that 4 year engagement didn't job-hop.
objections.reframe2: He became the person the client's own team leaned on.
objections.reframe3: That's what happens when the margin is fair and disclosed, not padded and hidden, and when the match is right from day one instead of rushed to fill a seat.

protocol.title: How the Quick Staffing Protocol works.
protocol.scopeText: You tell us the role, the stack, the niche requirement. We don't send you a questionnaire, we get on a call and get it exact.
protocol.matchText: We pull from developers already vetted for niche roles in your industry, not a cold search that starts after you sign.
protocol.placementText: You get a developer matched to your stack, ready to start. Billed hourly, at the salary rate plus our €10/h margin. No surprise invoices.
protocol.retentionText: If the fit works, the developer stays embedded in your team for as long as the project needs. The 4 year engagement is the proof this isn't a revolving door.

proof.title: One developer. One enterprise automotive project. Four years.
proof.p1: One of our developers spent 4 years embedded on a single enterprise automotive project.
proof.p2: He built the front-end from zero. Sole front-end developer on the team.
proof.p3: Delivered on time, in budget, at Senior standard. Zero quality issues.
proof.p4: He adapted through a Kanban to Scrum transition and an on-premise to cloud migration.
proof.p5: He mentored junior developers on his own initiative. Nobody asked him to.
proof.p6: The project lead told us he wants to bring him back through RSA SOFT for future projects.
proof.closing1: That's the standard we place developers to.
proof.closing2: The Protocol is how fast we do it.
proof.videoCaption: Hear it directly from a client RSA SOFT has delivered for.

talent.title: Every developer we place holds real, verifiable credentials.
talent.subtitle: Not just a resume claim. A credential you can check.

pricing.title: A flat €10/hour margin. No hidden markup layered on top of it.
pricing.ex1: A developer is outsourced to your project for 60 hours.
pricing.note: That's it. You see the developer's rate. You see our margin. Nothing else is baked in.
pricing.speedNote: Speed doesn't cost you a hidden premium. The rate stays the same whether the search takes 48 hours or 4 weeks.
pricing.wyg1: A developer matched to your niche stack in 24 to 48 hours, not months.
pricing.wyg2: Full visibility into what you're paying: salary rate + €10/h margin, nothing hidden.
pricing.wyg3: No legal exposure of a direct hire gone wrong.
pricing.wyg4: A developer who stays on your project long enough to know it as well as your own team does.
pricing.removesTitle: What this removes from your plate
pricing.rm1: The months-long search for specialized, niche staff.
pricing.rm2: The legal risk of getting a hire wrong.
pricing.rm3: The guesswork of what an agency is actually charging you on top of the developer's rate.
pricing.rm4: The risk of a developer who checks out halfway through the project.

fit.title: Tech Founders, CTOs, Heads of Software, Service Delivery Managers and Directors.
fit.p1: At DACH companies doing €500 million or more a year in automotive, banking or fintech.
fit.p2: You need a specific role filled. A niche stack, a niche framework, a niche compliance requirement your internal recruiter doesn't have a pipeline for.
fit.p3: You don't have 3 months. You have a sprint that starts Monday.
fit.gf1: Automotive, banking or fintech, doing €500M+ a year.
fit.gf2: Growing profit, scaling with custom-built software.
fit.gf3: Need to deliver faster, automate processes, cut operational costs.
fit.gf4: Open to a vetted specialist embedded in your team, not only direct hires.

finalCta.title: Every week that seat stays empty is another week your sprint slips.
finalCta.subtitle: You don't have 3 months. You have a sprint that starts Monday.

faq.title: What else you should know before you call.
faq.q1: How fast is a developer actually ready to start?
faq.a1: Usually 24 to 48 hours after the scope call: we draw from developers already vetted for your industry instead of starting the search after the contract is signed.
faq.q2: How does billing work, and what does it really cost?
faq.a2: Hourly, at the developer's rate plus a flat 10 €/hour margin. You see both numbers. Nothing extra is baked in, whether the search takes 48 hours or 4 weeks.
faq.a3: The difference is transparency: you see the developer's rate and our margin separately instead of one marked-up flat fee. No middleman skimming off the developer's pay without you seeing it.
faq.q4: What's the legal basis for the engagement?
faq.a4: Every custom software development engagement is governed by a separate written agreement signed before the project starts.
faq.q5: Does the developer only stick around for the first sprint, or longer-term?
faq.a5: As long as your project needs them. The reference case in our proof section ran 4 years on the same team.
